hero.description: The platform that connects clubs, players and tennis lovers all across Chile.

profiles.title: Player profiles
profiles.description: Create your profile and find rivals at your level.
profiles.modalBody: Your profile brings your level, match history and stats together in one place. Other players see it to propose challenges at your level, and you use it to choose who to play.

ladders.title: Ladders and tournaments
ladders.description: Compete in your club or across the whole community.
ladders.modalBody: Ladders let you compete inside your club: as you play, you earn points that set your position in the ranking. Tournaments are events run by each club, with dates and brackets defined by the club itself.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.description: Challenge other players and play matches.
challenges.modalBody: From any player's profile, a green button lets you send a direct challenge to arrange a match. To do so you must be registered and have your profile. If the other player accepts, a chat opens so you can agree on the day, time and place: a paid court or a free court in your area. Then enjoy a great match!

rankings.title: Automatic rankings
rankings.modalBody: Every ladder match you play adds points to your ranking. Your club's administrator logs the result and the system calculates everything automatically, with no manual updates. Your ranking updates on the site as soon as the match is recorded, so you can enjoy your progress in this great sport.

clubs.title: Clubs
clubs.description: Each club with its own ladder and tournaments.
clubs.modalBody: Each club has its own independent space within ChileTenis PRO, with its ladder, tournaments and player community.

challengeBanner.title: Find your next rival
challengeBanner.description: Play matches, improve your ranking and be part of the ChileTenis Pro community.

ranking.title: ChileTenis PRO Ranking
ranking.note: Adds up the real ladder points from each club.
ranking.empty: No players in the ranking yet.

clubCta.title: Have a club?
clubCta.description: Take your ladder and tournaments to the next level with ChileTenis Pro.
clubCta.emailSubject: I want to add my club to ChileTenis PRO
clubCta.emailBody: Hi, I'd like more information about adding my club to ChileTenis PRO.
